text:
Predicates:
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x is loaned out to y.
Nautico(y) ::: y is the Nautico football club.
Braga(y) ::: y is the Braga football club.
Question: ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Silva, Ailton) ∧ Footballer(Silva) ∧ LoanedOut(Silva, Braga) ∧ PlaysFor(Silva, Nautico) ∧ Brazilian(Silva) ∧ Nautico(Nautico) ∧ Braga(Braga) ∧ Nautico(Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico and was loaned to Braga.
Conclusion:
∀x (PlaysFor(x, Nautico) → ¬Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
